modelInclusion.frontierRule: Every model family on the Pareto frontier that Artificial Analysis (AA) renders on its Intelligence Index versus total cost to run chart is ranked, with the exact configuration AA selects on that line. Frontier membership is AA's rendered line as observed; ValueRank never recomputes it from rounded values.
modelInclusion.nearFrontierRule: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when its public (rounded integer) Intelligence Index is within 3 points of the rendered frontier's Index at its cost, meaning the highest Index among rendered-frontier points that cost no more. Every near-frontier family is ranked (its selected configuration may differ from the near configuration) or is explicitly deferred by a dated, reasoned roster decision. The cost ratio to the frontier is reported for information only.
modelInclusion.policyText: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when it lies within 3 Intelligence Index points of the rendered frontier at its cost. Every near-frontier model family must be in the primary ranking, with its own selected configuration, or be explicitly deferred with a dated, reasoned roster decision. The cost ratio to the cheapest frontier point of equal or higher intelligence is reported for information only.
